# Chimera 0.4 manual for the PreenFM3

> The complete user manual of Chimera, multi-engine firmware for the PreenFM3 synthesizer: what every page and control does, and why it was designed that way.

The whole manual is one Markdown file: [manual.md](/chimera-releases/manual/preenfm3/0.4/manual.md). Read it first; every heading is stable and every section names the screen's own labels.

## Chapters

- [Concepts: Parts, Sounds, projects and the voice chain](/chimera-releases/manual/preenfm3/0.4/01-concepts.md)
- [The panel and navigation](/chimera-releases/manual/preenfm3/0.4/02-panel-and-navigation.md)
- [ALGO, the six-operator engine](/chimera-releases/manual/preenfm3/0.4/03-algo.md)
- [MODAL, the physical-modelling engine](/chimera-releases/manual/preenfm3/0.4/04-modal.md)
- [VA, the variable-wave engine](/chimera-releases/manual/preenfm3/0.4/05-va.md)
- [TAPE, the sample engine](/chimera-releases/manual/preenfm3/0.4/06-tape.md)
- [DRUM, the kit engine](/chimera-releases/manual/preenfm3/0.4/07-drum.md)
- [The voice chain: pitch, filter, FX, amp, stereo and sends](/chimera-releases/manual/preenfm3/0.4/08-voice-chain.md)
- [Envelopes and LFOs](/chimera-releases/manual/preenfm3/0.4/09-envelopes-and-lfos.md)
